PR-20.reason: Add Muse colors, filters, names, handoff, read/ask/edit job controls and owner chat composer. The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-383.reason: AB-383: the dashboard subscribes to GET /api/events while the tab is visible and reads the shown chat or run at once when the history store reports new lines; pushes coalesce into one render and interval polling stays as the safety net; after an error, a visible tab retries the stream (1c75687f, page re-pinned). The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-400.reason: AB-400 (PR #92): outcomeChip adds a constant-text "result stored" / "result stored, not delivered" / "delivered" chip from state.jobs[job].resultStored and the job outcome's delivery receipt; poll() and loadOlder() merge job flags from older /api/runs pages (olderJobs). Page re-pinned from d9a04493 to ada58414. The optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.

AB-398.reason: AB-398: the desktop dashboard script shows a paused subagent job: "paused" becomes a known pill status styled like interrupted, a paused group keeps its place with the working ones, shows its pause reason and time in the row and conversation note, offers a resume_subagent hint, and the counts line adds "N paused" (6c3430d1, page re-pinned). The mobileDashboardPage addition, the optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged. Merged on top of AB-400 (PR #92): AB-400's outcomeChip now also runs for a paused group (it is not running), so it reads state.jobs only once state is loaded; the result-stored chip is otherwise unchanged.

AB-401.reason: AB-401: the desktop dashboard script shows a running job that is queued for a machine slot: pill() takes the group's waitingFor and renders a distinct `pill waiting` ("waiting · slot <name> #<position>", "waiting · startup #N" or "waiting · job limit #N", all escaped, with a title naming the holders); buildModel sets g.waitingFor only for a running group from a well-formed state.jobs[job].waitingFor (known kind, positive integer position, non-negative integer holders); groupRow and the conversation title pass it to pill(); the conversation note shows the wait; one CSS rule `.pill.waiting` uses the existing accent tokens. Page re-pinned. The mobileDashboardPage addition, the optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged (mobile-owner-startup's other 10 tests and mobile-activation pass). Re-checked after merging main with AB-404 (PR #95): the page script is unchanged by the merge and by the review fixes; the dashboard pill stays for running jobs' slot and startup waits only (a stored job-limit wait reaches /api/state and peers, not a pill).

AB-428.reason: AB-428: the desktop dashboard script shows a job checklist: buildModel sets g.checklist from the newest run (dashboard-read attaches the bridge checklist to it), runChips adds an escaped "checklist N/M" chip with the summary as title, and renderConversation fills a new hidden-by-default #cList element (escaped id, status, text and note per item; cleared in the other views). Five CSS rules (.clist) use existing tokens. Page re-pinned from 3f257b19 to 0eb9a5b7. ui.ts (uiSha256), the mobileDashboardPage addition, the optional mobile page and default mobile activation behavior are unchanged.
